page.overview:
Who is Rusty Rust-eze?

Rusty Rust-eze is a supporting character in Cars and Cars 3.

Rusty returned in Cars 3 alongside his brother Dusty, though like the original, they play minor roles. He and Dusty serve as McQueen's sponsor at the beginning of the film before handing ownership of Rust-Eze over to Sterling.

Due to the death of Rusty's voice actor Tom Magliozzi, Rusty speaks far less than Dusty in the film while all of his voice clips are archived recordings from his and Ray's radio show, Car Talk. He has only 8 lines in the film, being:

The rest of his dialogue consists of laughs and chuckles.
